description: Høyeste flomnivå august 2023 - Ringerike is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ringerike kommune. Datasettet viser høyeste flomnivå som ble registrert under uværet "Hans" i august 2023. Datasettet er basert på over 1500 bilder tatt fra helikopter under flommen og bilder tatt med vanlig kamera. FKB-Høydekurver er brukt som grunnlag for datasettet. Datasettet er avrundet til nærmeste hele meter. Coverage: Ringerike kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Ringerike kommune. Its keywords include Vær og klima, Ringerike kommune, Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2023-10-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
